# PR #102 — Rename max_price param on /search

**Status:** Merged, ships in v2.1
**Labels:** `api`, `v2.1`
**Author:** @eng-anowak

---

Renamed `max_price` → `max_price_minor` on `GET /search` to line up with the
billing service. Old name now returns `unknown_parameter`.

Part of the minor-units cleanup (BILL-212).

## Diff

```diff
--- a/mock-api/server.py
+++ b/mock-api/server.py
@@ def search(self, params):
-        allowed = {"from", "to", "trail_colour", "max_duration_hours", "max_price"}
-        raw = params.get("max_price", 5000)
-        budget = float(raw)
-        budget_minor = budget * 100
+        allowed = {"from", "to", "trail_colour", "max_duration_hours", "max_price_minor"}
+        raw = params.get("max_price_minor", 500000)
+        budget_minor = int(raw)  # grosze, same as price_minor on trips
```

## Testing

`SZLAK_API_VERSION=2.1 ./samples/run_samples.sh`
